title: galarhoeus tarokoensis
intro: Galarhoeus tarokoensis, commonly known as Taroko ginseng, is a type of plant that belongs to the nettle family (Urticaceae) and is native to Taiwan. It has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and anti-cancer properties. The therapeutic actions of Galarhoeus tarokoensis include promoting immune function, reducing stress and anxiety, and improving cardiovascular health. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
